column1: # flake      devbox.d/<flake> name (the package name in devbox.json)
# repo       the upstream GitHub repository the version is tracked against
# kind       how the flake obtains the versioned artifact:
#              asset    - downloads a release asset, so only a published
#              source   - builds from a git tag or a release source tree
#              registry - installs a registry package (npm/PyPI) whose version
# prefix     the upstream tag prefix of the release line the flake tracks
# major      the major version of that line (the line is prefix + major)
# installed  the version the flake pins today
# latest     the newest version upstream published in that line
# status     the status the table must show
